operations.name: Samuel Ely

expected.charges: Court obstruction and disturbances associated with the 1782 Massachusetts protests
expected.sentence: Six months; interrupted by a jailbreak, actual time served unresolved

operations.research_note: Temple, History of Whately pp.156-157 and Gazetteer of Hampshire County p.101 place arrest, guilty plea and Springfield imprisonment in April1782. Exact admission day not established: month precision only. Massachusetts Soldiers and Sailors official archival compilation, John Morgan Jr militia service entry, states Ely rescued Springfield jail June12,1782, corroborated state-library compilation. Some later retellings say June13; retain official archival date. Existing schema release_date records any custody end including escape. Six-month sentence not treated as actual term. Separate later confinement unresolved. No biography or notes changed.
